name: Osananajimi o Ushinatta Natsu...
original_name: 幼馴染を失った夏・・・
source:
Their town wasn't big enough to be called a city, but it wasn't too far off.
Tomoki Oosumi was more than happy to help Kanae Shinomiya prep for the local festival. She was shorthanded; her parents had left her to manage the shrine herself. It wasn't the first time, and it certainly wasn't a bother to Tomoki. Any excuse to hang out with her.

He arrived and started cleaning when Shinya Kaidou came around.
Shinya was the closest thing Tomoki had to a love rival. Hot-heated and quick to violence, Shinya never gave up trying to "get" Kanae
while only giving her more reasons to dislike him. Kanae knew aikido from her father, and today she used it on him.
Shinya was humiliated.

That night, a spot behind the shrine was vandalized.
Kanae didn't know the origin of this "hokura" or who broke it, but soon enough she heard rumors of demonic sightings and assaults around town. 
At the same time Tomoki noticed a change in Kanae.
Shinya was no longer coming around like before.
At night, he was having disturbing dreams......

Something terrible was unleashed when that hokura was broken------

translation:
他們所在的城鎮還不夠大，不能稱為城市，但也相去不遠。

大隅朋樹非常樂意幫助準備地方祭典的篠宮加奈。加奈人手不足，父母把神社交給她獨自管理。這不是第一次，也絕不會給朋樹添麻煩——只要能和她相處，什麼藉口都行。

他到達神社開始打掃時，海道真也出現了。真也是勉強算得上是朋樹的情敵，性格火爆、動輒訴諸暴力，卻從未放棄「得到」加奈，只是讓加奈更討厭他。加奈從父親那裡學過合氣道，今天便用在真也身上。真也受到了羞辱。

當天晚上，神社後方的一座小祠遭到破壞。加奈不知道這座「祠」的來歷，也不知道是誰毀了它，但鎮上很快傳出惡魔出沒、襲擊人類的傳聞。

與此同時，朋樹注意到加奈發生了變化。真也不再像以前那樣出現，夜裡還反覆做著令人不安的夢……

那座小祠被破壞時，某種可怕之物被釋放了——
